{"source_id":"MS002-SRC-A","verdicts":[
{"claim_id":"CL-0576","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0989 states the habit with all automations, and EV-0990 states going to the connector library to check for a pre-created ClickUp connector, oneshot connecting if present and more complicated work if not.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0989","EV-0990"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0577","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0993 shows asking Claude to query a specific list within a space and return information to verify the connection, and EV-0994 states 'I always want to start at the end just by verifying can I actually get that information'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0993","EV-0994"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0578","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1000 explicitly states the model was told to check rather than rely on the tool name list and reports the Gmail connector exposes create draft and update draft with no send message and no send draft.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0999","EV-1000"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0579","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1001 gives the 'not will I get a bug... but when' framing and EV-1002 gives the Gmail API with your own OAuth client option, the brief pipeline and the authentication script.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1001","EV-1002"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0580","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1003 and EV-1004 state that after authentication/logging in it sends a message to the speaker's own address to prove the whole path works without actually touching a client.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1003","EV-1004"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0581","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1005 gives the light, soft one-line nudges, EV-1006 gives the automatic loop rationale for not being pushy, and EV-1007 gives no m dashes, not mentioning the invoice number, and signing off with 'thanks - Nick'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1005","EV-1006","EV-1007"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0582","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1009 states 'we can never send two of these in a row if they're the exact same. They always need to be different templates.'","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1009"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0583","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1009 and EV-1010 give the once-per-day ClickUp query with the listed days-outstanding thresholds and sending an email template, and EV-1010/EV-1011 give filling merge variables with the prospect's actual information.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1009","EV-1010","EV-1011"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0584","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1012 states that after verifying a days-outstanding threshold match, go through all email conversation history with the prospect to see what follow-ups were sent so the exact same message is not sent twice.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1011","EV-1012","EV-1013"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0585","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1013 states the history check can't work with the token and that a read scope is to be added.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1013"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0586","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1017 gives the flag-on-ClickUp-task-and-don't-send instruction, EV-1018 gives the notes field and chase stage with a closed option, and EV-1020 gives the chase stage to closed plus a note and a comment for the audit trail.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1014","EV-1017","EV-1018","EV-1020"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0587","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1016 quotes the speaker asking to run on a 7-day threshold, go through the whole process end to end and report everything seen so the flow can be verified.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1016","EV-1017","EV-1018"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0588","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-0961 and EV-0962 state an app is easy to put together along with a data ingestion pipeline in probably 30 minutes, while using cheap models and being quite rate limited.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-0961","EV-0962","EV-0964"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0589","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1021 states 'verify the flag actually landed on the record. So now it's just going to double check that its job was done correctly.'","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1021"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0590","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1021 states it matched the 7-day records, searched Gmail, selected the template 'high net quick nudge on the invoice', then had an opt-out check, and EV-1022 completes 'whether or not that worked'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1021","EV-1022"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0591","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1022 states the speaker wants to verify which recipients went through the flow and that it was actually those three, noting three with seven-day flags.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1022"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0592","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1022 gives the instruction to run it for real using the info in the CRM and that Claude does this fairly often, and EV-1023 gives the token-avoidance reason described as generally reasonably positive behavior.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1022","EV-1023"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0593","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1023 states 44% of the way through the 5-hour limit resetting in 1 hour 27 minutes and that they are on Opus 5, a little bit smarter than Sonnet 5 used at the beginning.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1023"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0594","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1025 describes the 'please stop emailing me' reply and the chase stage set to closed with the system not continuing to follow up.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1025"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0595","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1026 and EV-1027 state converting everything talked about and all the fixes into a skill run once every morning, done manually for now and not as a loop.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1026","EV-1027"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0596","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1027 states the skill will go through 1 2 3 7 14 28 56 84 and so on, match to the templates appropriately, and do the opt-out check.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1027"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0597","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1028 states 'convert it into a simple bulleted SOP so that a future cloud instance that does not have the context of our conversation will still be able to execute this reliably'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1028"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0598","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1028 and EV-1029 state the connector is an MCP integration that only works inside a cloud session and that the skill as SOP looks for that script and uses its own built-in integration every time it is run.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1028","EV-1029"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0599","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1029 identifies turning it into a loop as the next step and EV-1030 specifies firing every morning at 5:59 a.m. and running using a cloud instance as opposed to locally on the computer.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1029","EV-1030"]},
{"claim_id":"CL-0600","judgment":"ENTAILED","entail_why":"EV-1030 states the ClickUp MCP integration can be added as a connector in the cloud environment and asks how to do the same, with EV-1031 completing the question with 'the local uh script'.","evidence_refs_checked":["EV-1030","EV-1031"]}
]}
